entries.5ff34653b8ce9b13: It manufactures sporting goods such as badminton, tennis and golf products at domestic plants and local subsidiaries in Asia, sells them in Japan itself and overseas through local subsidiaries and leading distributors in each country, and earns net sales. Of consolidated net sales of ¥163,643 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026, the Sporting Goods Business was ¥163,091 million, and among the 4 categories of goods, badminton goods were the largest at ¥101,707 million. The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that overseas markets account for about 7-tenths of consolidated net sales, and that sales to China, where the badminton market is large, amount to about 50% of consolidated net sales. Another feature is that it is not a company that only manufactures itself. The “Others” category, which includes wear, bags, etc., had net sales of ¥37,939 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026, but production results were ¥1,283 million and purchase results were ¥24,550 million, a category in which the ratio of purchasing and selling is far larger than that of manufacturing. The business is disclosed divided into a total of 5: the 4 regional Sporting Goods [[term:segment|reporting segments]] (Japan, Asia, North America and Europe) based on the sales structure, and the Sports Facilities Business, which operates golf courses, etc.
entries.60a0799d37f0eb19: It consists of YONEX CO., LTD. (the company) and 8 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]]. The 8 companies are YONEX CORPORATION in the United States, YONEX U.K. LIMITED in the United Kingdom, YONEX GmbH in Germany, YONEX SPORTS (CHINA) CO., LTD. in China, YONEX TAIWAN CO., LTD. in Taiwan, YONEX INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED in India, YONEX TECNIFIBRE CO., LTD. in Thailand, and Yonex Seiki Co., Ltd. in Japan. The annual securities report describes India and Thailand as manufacturing subsidiaries, and lists Taiwan as a local subsidiary that carries out both manufacturing and sales. Domestic manufacturing bases are the Niigata Factory (Nagaoka City, Niigata Prefecture) and the Tokyo Factory (Soka City, Saitama Prefecture), and the head office is in Bunkyo Ward, Tokyo. Of these, YONEX SPORTS (CHINA) CO., LTD. in China is cited in the annual securities report as a company whose net sales, excluding internal net sales among consolidated companies, were ¥80,692 million, accounting for more than 10% of consolidated net sales. The number of consolidated employees was 2,980 as of the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026 (in addition, the average number of temporary employees was 674).
